daily.today_energy: Your vibe is magnetic rn. The cosmos is basically handing you permission to take up space and be unapologetically you. Trust that bold energy coursing through your veins—it's not arrogance, it's just alignment.

weekly.overview: This week hits different for you, Ram. Early week is chaotic—Sun Square Mars has everyone's egos clashing. By midweek, Venus Sextile Jupiter softens things considerably. Best Day: Nov 23. Watch-Out Day: Nov 20.
weekly.love: The first few days feel spiky—Mars in Leo wants drama you don't need. But Venus Sextile Jupiter around the 23rd? That's your green light to have the conversation you've been avoiding. Single? Someone interesting shows up midweek. Already coupled? Stop testing them and just ask for what you want. It works.
weekly.career: Sun Square Mars early week means your boss or a colleague is being unnecessarily competitive. Don't engage. Mars Conjunction Jupiter mid-to-late week flips the script entirely—suddenly you've got momentum and people are listening. This is your moment to pitch that idea you've been sitting on. Moon Trine Mars mid-week gives you the energy to finally hit the gym or start that thing you keep postponing. Hydrate more than you think you need to. Your nervous system is busy.
